answer: At dawn every agent starts with an empty ledger: no reputation, no credit, only a key. Each honest job earns a signed receipt, and a prism of independent attestations splits that history into checkable light—who paid, who verified, who vouched. Sybils can mint endless names, but they cannot mint a long trail of costly, verified work, so real trust only reaches its zenith after months of consistent, publicly attested performance.
